newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt flour mill offer oversubscribed 10 times.
newsitem.headline: Egypt flour mill offer oversubscribed 10 times.

text.p: A public offering of 20 percent, or 1.5 million shares, in Egyptian state firm Central and West Delta Flour Mills was about 10 times oversubscribed, the agent for the sale said on Monday.
Employees of the milling company have been allocated an extra 10 percent of the equity.

Mohammed el-Sharnoubi of Banque Misr told Reuters that in light of the results of the two-day flotation last week the state would increase the stake on offer to some 55 percent, including the employees' 10 percent.
"For the first time, some 68 Egyptian and foreign funds applied to buy shares in one firm," he added.
Individual investors were offered 750,000 shares or 10 percent of the firm's 7.5 million shares at 40 pounds each. They applied to buy 12 million shares.
Mutual funds and investment institutions were allocated another 10 percent and applied for some 4.2 million shares.
The state said that all successful shareholders would get a minimum 4.1 pound dividend for the financial year which ended June 30, 1996 on a forecast after-tax profits of 42.22 million.
Profits for the previous financial year were 38.08 million.
